newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mostly down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mostly down on correction.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures settled lower on Monday, correcting after strong gains late last week, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract ended 130 lower at 16,660 yen per tonne. Spot May settled flat at 18,090 per tonne while the others were 320 to 190 lower. Volume was estimated at 74,104 lots.
On the CBOT Project A overnight trading system, the most-active March corn futures traded at $2.91-1/2 per bushel as of 0900 GMT, down 0-1/4 from Friday's close.
CBOT Project A March soybeans stood at $7.85-1/4 per bushel, up 2-1/4 from Friday.
